What is Eyebrow Restoration?

A Simple, Permanent Fix for Thin or Damaged Eyebrows

From over-plucking to hair loss conditions, eyebrow restoration helps bring your brows back—better than before.

Eyebrow restoration is a minimally invasive procedure where healthy hair is taken from the back of your scalp and carefully implanted into your eyebrow area. Each hair is placed with attention to angle, direction, and density—so the final look is natural, symmetrical, and soft.

This treatment is ideal for people with:

  • Over-plucked or naturally sparse brows

  • Scars or gaps in the eyebrow area

  • Hair loss from trauma, burns, or medical treatments

  • A desire for thicker, better-shaped eyebrows without makeup or tattooing

How Eyebrow Restoration Works

Our Step-by-Step Process – Designed with Precision and Care.

We don’t just fill in your brows—we artistically restore them to suit your face and features.

Step-by-Step Guide to Getting the Best Hair Transplant in Bangalore

✅ 1. Eyebrow Design & Consultation
We start by understanding your ideal eyebrow shape and thickness. A customized design is created based on your facial structure and aesthetic goals.
✅ 2. Donor Hair Extraction
Using the scar-free FUE technique, we extract individual hair follicles from the back of your scalp.
✅ 3. Precision Implantation
Each graft is meticulously implanted into your eyebrows—one hair at a time—to match the natural angle and flow of brow hair.
✅ 4. Recovery & Regrowth
There’s no hospital stay. Minor redness fades in a day or two. Hair shedding is normal in the first month, with visible new growth beginning in 3–4 months, and final results appearing by 8–12 months.
